articles.summary: Unlocks Growth Potential of Over 200,000 Institutions Ategrity Specialty Insurance Company Holdings (NYSE: ASIC) today announced the launch of Ategrity Select Religious Organizations, the latest addition to its pre-priced platform. The company has pre-qualified and pre-priced more than 200,000 religious institutions across the United States for comprehensive property and casualty coverage.
